one_line: The conjectured range holds for graphs with fractional chromatic number χ_f(G) satisfying χ_f(G)d\log n=o(n), in particular for every bipartite regular graph, while for arbitrary regular graphs one obtains optimal one-bin variance and concentration of a natural spacing predictor.
caveats: The simultaneous result for arbitrary high-chromatic regular graphs remains open; novelty relative to the literature has not been checked.
